Create one full finished game UI screen, no surrounding presentation board or extra panels.
Transfer to the new unified geometric cut-paper collage visual language: deliberate large angular cut silhouettes, restrained folded planes, flat saturated colored card stock, short subtle cast shadows ONLY between overlapping paper layers, warm cream paper. Do not flatten all colors into brown. Functional labels use the existing clear brush-letter style; labels are ivory clipped-corner paper with thin vermilion rule. Button is shallow crimson cut-paper rectangle with two clipped corners and warm ivory text; secondary button cream with thin dark brown line. Same stars everywhere: plain five point cut-paper shape, ochre filled when earned, cream with brown outline when empty. Same P1 teal circle and P2 vermilion diamond, white P numerals. No glossy gradients, bevelled plastic, futuristic widgets, extra explanatory paragraphs, new controls, human characters, weapons, rarity letters, talismans, gacha, or text from the unrelated style reference cards.

EXACT new paper design from image3, fitted to source1 pose and footprint. Do not add a thick ornamental board or deer emblem.
4 烘栗 (male red panda pointed ears, broad round face and massive ring-tail silhouette, holding open folding fan): UNSELECTED uniform same deep-brown SILHOUETTE, no interior face or clothes details.
